script: Birds are not just related to dinosaurs, they are dinosaurs. They are the only dinosaurs that survived the asteroid 66 million years ago. Many dinosaurs had feathers long before any could fly. Birds share many skeleton features with small meat-eating dinosaurs. That includes hollow bones and a wishbone. There are about 11,000 species of birds alive today. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
